description:
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Copy Artifact by paying {1}{U}, having it enter the battlefield as a copy of Seat of the Synod.
Activate Copy Artifact by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Tameshi's second ability by paying {W} and returning Copy Artifact from the battlefield to your hand, returning Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
